Patient_Actor.history: A 27-year-old male presents to his primary care physician with lower back pain. He notes that the pain started over a year ago but has become significantly worse over the past few months. The pain is most severe in the mornings. His past medical history is unremarkable except for a recent episode of right eye pain and blurry vision. Radiographs of the spine and pelvis show bilateral sacroiliitis. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment for this patient?
